mechanics.claim: Headbutt only deals damage and applies effects if the enemy is within 400 units upon arrival of the dash.
mechanics.quote: If they are within 400 units upon arrival, he deals them {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Alistar's attack range is reduced during Headbutt, preventing him from auto-attacking on arrival, which matters for attack-reset/on-hit sequencing.
If Pulverize is buffered during the Headbutt dash, the knockback distance is reduced and Pulverize overrides the knockback with a knockup.
mechanics.quote: When {{ai|Pulverize|Alistar}} is buffered during the dash, the knock back distance is reduced to 200 units.
